tip.title: Offer the first serving as prasad mindset
tip.idea: Even a home meal can be cooked as an offering — care first, rush second. That is the heart of Pure Prasad Kitchen.
tip.action: Plate the first serving neatly as if for a guest, then eat mindfully.

note: Launch day tip. From tomorrow, the page auto-rotates a new idea each calendar day, and the Cursor daily automation can write a fresh tip into this file.
